description: Copies a list of longwords from the input pointer into three destination buffers at once, stopping at the sentinel value minus two, and saves the advanced destination pointers back into globals. This is the same copy loop as a neighbouring entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:18D0
name: spin_in_infinite_loop
description: Contains no work and never returns: its only body is an endless loop. The entry acts as an idle or halt trap, and its two helper calls do nothing meaningful.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:18DC
name: swap_copper_list_buffers
description: Compares the current copper list pointer slot with a candidate and, when they differ, switches to a second buffer placed 8000 bytes away, then selects the next state word. It starts the copper list through a helper, as its listed calls show.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:1926
name: rotate_three_copper_list_slots
description: Chooses among three copper list slot values: it compares the active slot with the others and rotates the three slots, storing the chosen index in a global. The copper list pointer register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:195C
name: advance_three_copper_slots
description: Unconditionally shifts three copper slot values one position along and stores a fourth value in a global, with no comparison. The copper list pointer register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:197E
name: permute_three_copper_slots
description: Reorders three copper slot values by a fixed permutation and stores a fourth value in a global. The register list also names the background colour register, although the shown body does not write it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:1E6C
name: acknowledge_keyboard_serial_byte
description: When a flag bit is set, it inverts and rotates a received byte into a key code with an up or down state, then runs a short handshake that waits on a CIA-side bit and clears it. It works through the keyboard serial register, the CIA timer registers and the interrupt request register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:1EF4
name: decode_joystick_direction_bits
description: Reads the joystick data register and combines pairs of its bits into direction flags, merges the fire-button state from the CIA port into a flag byte, and increments a counter. It finishes by writing the interrupt request register to clear its flags.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:1F64
name: clear_interrupt_request_flags
description: Writes a fixed mask to the interrupt request register to clear the pending flags, then returns a stacked word. It is a small acknowledge step with no other logic.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2060
name: step_and_bound_two_positions
description: Moves two position counters by a step value, bouncing each back inside a bound taken from a neighbouring word, and records direction flags in a byte. It then copies the resulting state into a control word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2108
name: apply_position_flags_with_bounds
description: Applies the recorded direction flags to two position counters, clamping each against a bound and reversing the step when it would overshoot. It returns the updated flag byte packed with a status word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:21DC
name: scale_paddle_values_to_flags
description: Scales two input values by stored factors, clamps each around a centre value of 127 within a narrow band, and sets direction flags when a value falls outside it. It reads the paddle counter registers and writes the port control flags.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2202
name: clamp_paddle_axis_flags
description: Clamps two paddle axis values around a centre value of 127 and sets flags for each axis that leaves the band. It then writes the port control flags and sets a global to one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:220E
name: clamp_single_paddle_axis
description: Clamps one paddle axis value around a centre value of 127, sets a flag when it leaves the band, and writes the port control flags. It resets a global to a fixed value first.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2222
name: clamp_paddle_upper_limit
description: Clamps the second paddle axis against an upper limit and sets a flag when it is exceeded, then runs the same downward check on the first axis. It writes the port control flags at the end.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:222E
name: set_paddle_centre_flags
description: Resets the paddle axis value to its centre and checks the first axis for a downward excursion, writing the port control flags. The shorter logic gives no other behaviour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2258
name: test_paddle_axis_centre
description: Tests one paddle axis against its centre value and sets port flags accordingly, then writes the same port control flags as its neighbours. It uses a single comparison, with no clamping.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2276
name: start_paddle_potentiometer_scan
description: Sets a global to one to start the potentiometer scan, then derives port control flags from the joystick input register and the test value passed in. It is a short scan-and-flag step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:23B0
name: multiply_random_and_swap_halves
description: Calls a generator routine, multiplies its low word by an odd factor derived from the input, and returns the product with its two halves swapped. It is a scrambling step for random values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:23C2
name: advance_linear_congruential_seed
description: Updates a 16-bit seed with a multiplier of 41 and an increment of 73, the usual linear congruential step, and returns. It is a pseudo-random sequence generator.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:27F8
name: program_blitter_per_row
description: Waits for the blitter to be free, then loads its modulo, mask, source, destination and control registers for each row, advancing pointers by a stride and selecting the control shift from a table bit. It also reads the DMA control register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:28B6
name: queue_blitter_row_registers
description: For each row, waits until a busy flag clears, then writes control, pointer and size registers for the blitter, advancing the source pointer by a stride. It returns the accumulated value after the last row.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2950
name: translate_entries_through_table
description: Loops over forty-nine longword entries in the globals, replacing each one with the value found at its own index in a lookup table. It is a single mapping pass with no other outputs.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2A32
name: claim_audio_priority_slot
description: Records the requested value into the first free of four audio slot words, using the value one as a special case that is written to its own slot. It clears the request value on exit and returns the input unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2A36
name: claim_audio_priority_slot
description: Records the requested value into the first free of four audio slot words, using the value one as a special case that is written to its own slot. It clears the request value on exit and returns the input unchanged.

name: claim_audio_priority_slot
description: Records the requested value into the first free of four audio slot words, using the value one as a special case that is written to its own slot. It clears the request value on exit and returns the input unchanged.

name: claim_audio_priority_slot
description: Records the requested value into the first free of four audio slot words, using the value one as a special case that is written to its own slot. It clears the request value on exit and returns the input unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2A42
name: claim_audio_priority_slot
description: Records the requested value into the first free of four audio slot words, using the value one as a special case that is written to its own slot. It clears the request value on exit and returns the input unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2A46
name: claim_audio_priority_slot
description: Records the requested value into the first free of four audio slot words, using the value one as a special case that is written to its own slot. It clears the request value on exit and returns the input unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2A4A
name: claim_audio_priority_slot
description: Records the requested value into the first free of four audio slot words, using the value one as a special case that is written to its own slot. It clears the request value on exit and returns the input unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2A52
name: claim_audio_channel_three_slot
description: Records the requested value into a free audio slot, using the value one as a special case, and clears the request. The audio channel three location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2A92
name: claim_audio_channel_two_slot
description: Checks three audio slot words and records the requested value into the first free one, then clears the request. The audio channel two location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2AC2
name: claim_audio_channel_one_slot
description: Records the requested value into one of two audio slot words if it is free, then clears the request. The audio channel one location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2AF2
name: claim_audio_channel_zero_slot
description: Records the requested value into a free audio slot if one of three is available, then clears the request. The audio channel zero location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2B26
name: release_audio_slots_channel_zero
description: Compares the requested value with the stored audio slot values and clears any slot holding it, then resets a global. The audio channel zero location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2B4A
name: release_audio_slots_channel_one
description: Compares the requested value with three stored audio slot values and clears the global when one matches. The audio channel one location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2B62
name: release_audio_slots_channel_two
description: Compares the requested value with two stored audio slot values and clears the global when one matches. The audio channel two location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2B78
name: release_audio_slot_channel_one
description: Compares the requested value with one stored audio slot value and clears the global when it matches. The audio channel one location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2B98
name: reset_all_audio_channels
description: Writes fixed values into the state words of all four audio channels and clears their slot words. The register list also names the location, length, period, volume and DMA control registers, which are written by the same routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2C8A
name: initialise_audio_driver_state
description: Clears a block of about 205 driver words, sets default channel and index values, and points the driver at its tables. It sets up the state for later audio updates.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2DCC
name: update_audio_channel_states
description: Runs once per update when not already marked busy, and for each of four channels checks its state words and calls the matching helper. It is the main per-tick driver loop for the audio channels.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2E1A
name: step_audio_sequence_commands
description: Advances a channel's sequence pointer by reading a command word and dispatching it through a switch: a zero command ends the sequence, and other commands load a length counter and volume-related flags. It is the per-channel sequencer step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2E28
name: load_voice_sequence_pointer
description: Loads the sequence pointer for a voice from a table indexed by the voice's slot, then clears that slot and a counter. It prepares a voice to start reading a new sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2E4A
name: step_audio_sequence_channel_zero
description: Advances a channel zero sequence: when the step counter is zero it reads the next command word and dispatches it through a switch, where zero ends the sequence. Otherwise it counts down the step and writes the channel zero DMA mask, and the channel zero location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2E60
name: step_audio_sequence_voice_one
description: Advances the first voice's sequence: it reads the next command when the step counter reaches zero, a zero command ends the sequence, and other commands set a length counter and a DMA mask for channel zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2EBA
name: step_audio_sequence_voice_two
description: Advances the second voice's sequence by reading the next command when its counter is exhausted and dispatching it through a switch, then stepping the counter down. It sets a length count and clears a flag on the other branch.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2EC8
name: load_voice_sequence_pointer
description: Loads the sequence pointer for a voice from a table indexed by the voice's slot, then clears that slot and a counter. It prepares a voice to start reading a new sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2EEA
name: step_audio_sequence_channel_one
description: Advances a channel one sequence by reading the next command when its counter is exhausted, dispatching it through a switch, and writing the channel one DMA mask. The channel one location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2F00
name: step_channel_one_sequence_alt
description: Advances an alternative channel one sequence by reading the next command when its counter is exhausted and dispatching it, then stepping the counter down. It writes the channel one DMA mask and the location register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2F5A
name: step_audio_sequence_voice_three
description: Advances the third voice's sequence: it reads a command word when its counter is exhausted, dispatches zero as the end marker and other values as length and pointer updates, then steps the counter down.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2F68
name: load_voice_sequence_pointer
description: Loads the sequence pointer for a voice from a table indexed by the voice's slot, then clears that slot and a counter. It prepares a voice to start reading a new sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2F8A
name: step_audio_sequence_channel_two
description: Advances a channel two sequence by reading the next command when its counter is exhausted, dispatching it through a switch, and writing the channel two DMA mask. The channel two location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2FA0
name: step_channel_two_sequence_alt
description: Advances an alternative channel two sequence by reading the next command when its counter is exhausted and dispatching it, then stepping the counter down. It writes the channel two DMA mask and the location register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:2FFC
name: step_audio_sequence_voice_four
description: Advances the fourth voice's sequence by reading the next command when its counter is exhausted, dispatching zero as the end marker, and stepping the counter down otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3008
name: load_voice_sequence_pointer
description: Loads the sequence pointer for a voice from a table indexed by the voice's slot, then clears that slot and a counter. It prepares a voice to start reading a new sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:302A
name: step_audio_sequence_channel_three
description: Advances a channel three sequence by reading the next command when its counter is exhausted, dispatching it through a switch, and writing the channel three DMA mask. The channel three location register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:303E
name: step_channel_three_sequence_alt
description: A larger variant of the channel three sequencer: it reads the next command when its counter is exhausted, dispatches it, adjusts the length and volume words, and writes the channel three DMA mask. The DMA control register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3220
name: read_next_sequence_value
description: Reads the next value from a sequence stream into a voice structure, choosing one of two sources from a stored type, and adjusts it by an offset or mask before returning. It also sets a DMA-related flag in the voice state.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32A0
name: start_voice_sequence_from_pointer
description: Reads the first command of a sequence, dispatching zero as an end marker, then loads the sequence length, data pointer and envelope words for the voice. It starts the voice from the beginning of its sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32A6
name: start_voice_sequence_clear_flag
description: Clears one flag bit in the shared control byte, then starts a sequence the same way as its neighbours: it dispatches the first command and loads the voice's length and pointer words. The CIA port register is listed as touched.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32B2
name: start_voice_sequence_set_flag
description: Sets one flag bit in the shared control byte, then starts a sequence by dispatching its first command and loading the voice's length and pointer words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32BE
name: load_envelope_and_start_voice
description: Copies a pointer and a short envelope block from the header into the voice, or three longwords when the type is non-zero, then starts the voice by dispatching its first command.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32D4
name: copy_envelope_and_start_voice
description: Copies four words of envelope data from a source block into the voice state, then starts the voice by dispatching its first command and loading length and pointer words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:32E8
name: start_voice_from_indirect_list
description: Takes the next entry from an indirect pointer list, then starts the voice by dispatching its first command and loading length and pointer words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3300
name: start_voice_from_pointer_table
description: Loads a longword pointer from the table into the voice, then starts the voice by dispatching its first command and loading length and pointer words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:330E
name: start_voice_with_header_block
description: Copies two longwords and a word from a header block into the voice, then starts it by dispatching the first command and loading its length and pointer words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:331A
name: start_voice_with_flagged_header
description: Marks the voice as active, copies three longwords from a header block, then starts it by dispatching its first command and loading length and pointer words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2).adf:library:0:3330
name: start_voice_clear_offset
description: Clears the voice's offset word, then starts it by dispatching its first command and loading length and pointer words.
